# 2 Baruch Chapter 25 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And he answered and said to me: You also will be preserved until that time — until the sign which the Most High will perform for the inhabitants of the earth at the end of days.

**2** This therefore will be the sign: when terror and confusion seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they fall into many tribulations and are cast into great torments —

**3** And it will come to pass that when they say in their thoughts, because of their many afflictions: The Mighty One no longer remembers the earth — then it will come.

**4** And at that time, when the Most High is about to visit the world which he made, he will command a sign against the peoples, and many tribulations will come upon them.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The chapter establishes the eschatological sign: extreme suffering leading to despair about God's presence, which paradoxically signals the imminent arrival of the end. Baruch is told he will be preserved to witness this sign.*
